trigger_condition.dtype_trigger: Boolean CUDA tensor and Python bool scalar
trigger_condition.execution_trigger: Binary element-wise multiplication dispatches to CUDA bool kernel
trigger_condition.concrete_constraints: Multiply a CUDA boolean tensor by a Python bool scalar using '*' or torch.mul; CPU path works, CUDA path raises RuntimeError.

harness_strategy.input_mutation: Generate scalar-tensor combinations covering Python scalar types (bool, int, float) and tensor dtypes including bool.
harness_strategy.tensor_construction: Create CUDA boolean tensors with varied shapes and compare against CPU boolean tensors.
harness_strategy.constraint_injection: Force device/dtype combinations for element-wise binary ops, especially CUDA bool tensors with Python bool scalars.
harness_strategy.operation_sequence: Apply torch.mul and '*' with both scalar-tensor and tensor-scalar operand orders; run on CPU and CUDA.
harness_strategy.oracle_construction: Flag any exception or inconsistent CPU/CUDA behavior for dtype combinations that should be supported.
